subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale guard expectations are repaired and the final exact head is green, should the credentialed, scanning, publishing, automation, and Codex action upgrades land as one grouped rollup?
rationale: Automated validation can prove revision consistency, but coordinated replacement of third-party executable code across several credential and security boundaries requires owner intent.

options.title: Approve grouped rollup
options.body: Repair all guards, validate the exact head, and land the verified official action revisions together.

options.title: Split privileged families
options.body: Separate token, scanning, publishing, repository-automation, and Codex updates for narrower owner review.

options.title: Pause grouped update
options.body: Close or supersede the rollup if Dependabot cannot preserve the repository-specific guard repairs.

recommendation.title: Approve grouped rollup
recommendation.body: Repair all guards, validate the exact head, and land the verified official action revisions together.

likelyOwner.reason: This team owns the central security-scanning and Dependency Guard workflows changed by the PR.
